scope: One finite public OS process-accounting pass following failed host headroom gates; not a perception observer or allocator diagnostic.
privacy: Only executable basename, PID, parent PID, uid and OS start are retained; unrelated command-line arguments/full executable paths are not retained.
limits: Process readings are sequential and not an atomic whole-host snapshot.
Denied, exiting or identity-changing processes are unavailable/inconclusive without elevation or retries.
Physical footprint is OS accounting, not allocator attribution or proof of a leak.
RSS and physical footprint are different accounting measures; no additive total or safe-removal recommendation is inferred.
This snapshot cannot turn failed sustained headroom gates into qualification acceptance.
